mode.description:
The mode of the experiment. The mode determines how `classes` must be specified:
  - `tool_calling`: Agentic tool use. Each item in `classes` represents a tool the model can call.
  - `judge`: LLM-as-judge for scoring outputs against a single metric. `classes` must contain exactly one item.
  - `decision`: Multi-class decision/classification. Each item in `classes` represents a possible decision label.
  - `routing`: Route an input between possible destinations. Each item in `classes` represents a route.
  - `ner`: Named entity recognition. Each item in `classes` represents an entity type to extract.
  - `regression`: Score an input on a numeric scale. `classes` must contain exactly one item.

classes.description:
The classes for the experiment. The shape and length constraints depend on `mode`:
  - `tool_calling`, `decision`, `routing`, `ner`: one or more items, each with `name` and `description`.
  - `judge`: exactly one item where `name` is the metric name and `description` is the judgment criteria.
  - `regression`: exactly one item with `name`, `description`, plus the additional required fields `min_value`, `max_value`, `low_description`, `high_description`, and `higher_means`.

oneOf.title: JudgeClass
oneOf.description: Used for `judge` mode. `classes` must contain exactly one item of this type.

name.description: The name of the metric being judged.

description.example: Rate how helpful the response is in addressing the user's question.
description.description: The criteria the judge should use to evaluate the response.

oneOf.title: RegressionClass
oneOf.description: Used for `regression` mode. `classes` must contain exactly one item of this type.

description.description: A description of what the metric measures.

min_value.description: The minimum value of the score range.

max_value.description: The maximum value of the score range.

low_description.example: Poor quality response that does not address the question.
low_description.description: A description of what a score at `min_value` represents.

high_description.example: Excellent response that fully addresses the question.
high_description.description: A description of what a score at `max_value` represents.
